provenance.languageBy: Muse Spark (muse-spark-1.3) via the Meta Model API — the same API the Ship Safe screener uses
provenance.rule: The model wrote words only. Every number, cost, and decision in this demo is computed by js/engine.js from data/*.json. Tokens like {{dollars}} are filled by the app from engine output.
provenance.userWordsRule: Second clause (Career Development Faye, 2026-10-17): user words are data, not raw material. Interview answers, override reasons, and anything the mirror quotes pass through VERBATIM — the engine carries them, the model never paraphrases them. Spark phrases agent-side narration around engine facts and user text; it does not rewrite user text, ever.

strings.interviewIntro: I'm the new agent on this account, and before I plan anything I need to learn how you work. This takes about two minutes.

questions.ask: For Hartline Stores, what does on-time mean?

options.label: By appointment time
options.sub: Dock arrival by appointment time, no grace.

options.label: On the promised day
options.sub: Any time that day counts as on time.

questions.ask: Hartline S-102 shows non-stackable. Is that right?

options.label: Correct, no stack
options.sub: Nothing rides on top of it.

options.label: It can stack
options.sub: System profile is wrong, it stacks fine.

questions.ask: Cheap carrier is shaky and it is anchor freight. Which way do I lean?

options.label: Protect the client
options.sub: Pay for reliability on anchor freight.

options.label: Cheapest first
options.sub: Take the savings, flag the risk for me.

strings.landingLine: That is the foundation, next I show you what I heard.
strings.mirrorIntro: Here is what I heard, correct me where I am wrong, nothing is saved until you say so.
strings.mirrorDelta: One item differs from the facility default: {{deltaText}}, confirm or fix it.
strings.silenceLine: No struggles on this one, I speak up when it counts.
strings.payoffLine: I changed this because you taught me {{reason}}.
strings.teachPrompt: Say the rule you want me to remember.
strings.streakCaption: Last {{total}} proposals: {{taken}} taken as-is, {{changed}} changed, {{rejected}} rejected.
